rules.title: Just Cause Required for Termination of Tenancy (San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7)
rules.requirement: Landlords must give tenants notice of protections, give cure notice for at-fault terminations, give 30/60-day written notice with stated basis for no-fault terminations, notify the Commission, and pay relocation assistance (two months' rent, three for seniors/disabled) or waive rent for no-fault terminations. Tenants have a right of first offer if the unit is re-rented within five years; buyout agreements are regulated and void if noncompliant or below relocation amount; retaliation is prohibited.
rules.key_value: Relocation assistance: 2 months' actual rent (3 months if tenant is senior or disabled); no-fault notice 30 or 60 days; offer-to-renew right for 5 years
rules.penalty: Failure to comply voids the termination notice; wrongful eviction damages of at least three times actual economic damages; at least three times required relocation assistance plus actual damages; punitive damages and attorney's fees; city enforcement including civil and criminal remedies.
rules.citation: San Diego Municipal Code §§98.0705-98.0710 (Ch. 9, Art. 8, Div. 7); O-21647 N.S.; O-21769 N.S.
rules.status_basis: Added 5-25-2023 by O-21647 N.S., effective 6-24-2023; amended 2-27-2024 by O-21769 N.S., effective 3-28-2024.

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property subject to the Division (coverage definitions appear in an earlier chunk).
